papers.title: Improving Language Understanding from Screenshots
papers.authors: Tianyu Gao, Zirui Wang, Adithya Bhaskar, Danqi Chen
papers.affiliations: Princeton Language and Intelligence (PLI), Princeton University
papers.intro: 论文提出一种新颖的Patch-and-Text Prediction (PTP)预训练目标，通过同时预测截图中的图像块和文本，让截图语言模型在仅以视觉为输入的情况下，在GLUE上达到与BERT相当的性能。

papers.title: YOLOv9: Learning What You Want to Learn Using Programmable Gradient Information
papers.authors: Chien-Yao Wang, I-Hau Yeh, Hong-Yuan Mark Liao
papers.affiliations: Institute of Information Science, Academia Sinica, Taiwan National Taipei University of Technology, Taiwan Department of Information and Computer Engineering, Chung Yuan Christian University, Taiwan
papers.intro: 本文提出可编程梯度信息（PGI）和广义高效层聚合网络（GELAN），从信息瓶颈和可逆函数角度解决深度网络中的信息丢失问题，使得从头训练的模型在目标检测任务上优于使用大数据集预训练的最先进方法。

papers.title: CoCo-Agent: A Comprehensive Cognitive MLLM Agent for Smartphone GUI Automation
papers.authors: Xinbei Ma, Zhuosheng Zhang, Hai Zhao
papers.affiliations: 上海交通大学（School of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Key Laboratory of Shanghai Education Commission for Intelligent Interaction and Cognitive Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Key Laboratory of Trusted Data Circulation and Governance in Web3）
papers.intro: CoCo-Agent 提出综合环境感知（CEP）和条件动作预测（CAP）两个创新方法，基于LLaVA骨干在智能手机GUI自动化任务上实现了新的最优性能，通过细致化感知和结构化动作分解系统性地提升了智能体在真实场景中的表现。

papers.title: OS-Copilot: Towards Generalist Computer Agents with Self-Improvement
papers.authors: Zhiyong Wu, Chengcheng Han, Zichen Ding, Zhenmin Weng, Zhoumianze Liu, Shunyu Yao, Tao Yu, Lingpeng Kong
papers.affiliations: Shanghai AI Laboratory, East China Normal University, Princeton University, The University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文提出OS-Copilot框架，并基于它构建了具备自我改进能力的通用计算机代理FRIDAY，通过统一接口和自主学习机制在GAIA基准上超越以往方法35%。

papers.title: ScreenAgent: A Vision Language Model-driven Computer Control Agent
papers.authors: Runliang Niu, Jindong Li, Shiqi Wang, Yali Fu, Xiyu Hu, Xueyuan Leng, He Kong, Yi Chang, Qi Wang
papers.affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence, Jilin University; Engineering Research Center of Knowledge-Driven Human-Machine Intelligence, Ministry of Education, China
papers.intro: 提出ScreenAgent，一个构建在VNC环境中的VLM智能体，通过规划-执行-反思的自动化控制流程，能够观察屏幕截图并输出鼠标键盘动作，完成多步计算机控制任务，在训练后达到与GPT-4V相当的能力并具有更精确的UI定位。

papers.title: WebLINX: Real-World Website Navigation with Multi-Turn Dialogue
papers.authors: Xing Han Lù, Zdeněk Kasner, Siva Reddy
papers.affiliations: Xing Han L`u - Mila Quebec AI Institute, McGill University; Zdenˇek Kasner - Mila Quebec AI Institute, Institute of Formal and Applied Linguistics, Charles University; Siva Reddy - Mila Quebec AI Institute, McGill University, Facebook CIFAR AI Chair
papers.intro: 论文提出WebLINX——一个包含2337个专家演示、覆盖155个真实网站的大规模多轮对话式网站导航基准，并设计了基于检索的HTML压缩方法和动作特异性评估指标，系统评估了多种文本/多模态模型的表现，发现微调的小型文本模型优于零样本GPT-4V，但所有模型泛化到新网站时性能显著下降。

papers.title: UFO: A UI-Focused Agent for Windows OS Interaction
papers.authors: Chaoyun Zhang, Liqun Li, Shilin He, Xu Zhang, Bo Qiao, Si Qin, Minghua Ma, Yu Kang, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang, Qi Zhang
papers.affiliations: Microsoft
papers.intro: UFO是一个针对Windows OS的双代理框架，利用GPT-Vision的视觉能力，通过观察桌面和应用截图、选择合适应用并执行原子UI操作，自动完成跨应用的复杂用户请求。

papers.title: ScreenAI: A Vision-Language Model for UI and Infographics Understanding
papers.authors: Gilles Baechler, Srinivas Sunkara, Maria Wang, Fedir Zubach, Hassan Mansoor, Vincent Etter, Victor Cărbune, Jason Lin, Jindong Chen, Abhanshu Sharma
papers.tags: multimodal learning, OCR, object detection, gui
papers.affiliations: Google DeepMind
papers.intro: ScreenAI是一种基于PaLI架构并结合pix2struct灵活分块策略的视觉语言模型，通过创新的屏幕注释任务和利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成大规模训练数据，专门用于UI和信息图表的理解，在多项基准上以5B参数达到或接近最先进水平。

papers.title: Dual-View Visual Contextualization for Web Navigation
papers.authors: Jihyung Kil, Chan Hee Song, Boyuan Zheng, Xiang Deng, Yu Su, Wei-Lun Chao
papers.affiliations: The Ohio State University
papers.intro: 本文提出 Dual-View Contextualized Representation (DUAL-VCR)，通过利用网页截图中HTML元素的空间邻居关系，结合文本和视觉特征对每个元素进行上下文化，从而提升自动网页导航的性能。

papers.title: MobileVLM V2: Faster and Stronger Baseline for Vision Language Model
papers.authors: Xiangxiang Chu, Limeng Qiao, Xinyu Zhang, Shuang Xu, Fei Wei, Yang Yang, Xiaofei Sun, Yiming Hu, Xinyang Lin, Bo Zhang, Chunhua Shen
papers.affiliations: Meituan Inc., Zhejiang University, Dalian University of Technology
papers.intro: MobileVLM V2通过精心设计的高质量数据、全参数训练策略和极轻量的下采样投影器LDPv2，在保持移动设备上高推理速度的同时，使1.7B模型达到或超越3B模型水平，3B模型超越多个7B+模型，实现了性能与速度的新SOTA平衡。

papers.title: Mobile-Agent: Autonomous Multi-Modal Mobile Device Agent with Visual Perception
papers.authors: Junyang Wang, Haiyang Xu, Jiabo Ye, Ming Yan, Weizhou Shen, Ji Zhang, Fei Huang, Jitao Sang
papers.affiliations: Beijing Jiaotong University, Alibaba Group
papers.intro: 本文提出Mobile-Agent，一种纯视觉的自主移动设备代理，通过视觉感知工具（OCR和图标检测）结合GPT-4V实现操作定位、任务自规划和自反思，在全新基准Mobile-Eval上展现出高完成率和操作精度。

papers.title: WebVoyager: Building an End-to-End Web Agent with Large Multimodal Models
papers.authors: Hongliang He, Wenlin Yao, Kaixin Ma, Wenhao Yu, Yong Dai, Hongming Zhang, Zhenzhong Lan, Dong Yu
papers.affiliations: Hongliang He - Zhejiang University, Westlake University; Wenlin Yao - Tencent AI Lab; Kaixin Ma - Tencent AI Lab; Wenhao Yu - Tencent AI Lab; Yong Dai - Tencent AI Lab; Hongming Zhang - Tencent AI Lab; Zhenzhong Lan - Westlake University; Dong Yu - Tencent AI Lab
papers.intro: 提出WebVoyager，一种基于大型多模态模型（LMM）的端到端web agent，通过与真实网站直接交互完成用户指令，并建立了新基准和基于GPT-4V的自动评估协议，显著优于现有的文本或纯视觉方案。

papers.title: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visual Web Tasks
papers.authors: Jing Yu Koh, Robert Lo, Lawrence Jang, Vikram Duvvur, Ming Chong Lim, Po-Yu Huang, Graham Neubig, Shuyan Zhou, Ruslan Salakhutdinov, Daniel Fried
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University
papers.intro: VisualWebArena 是一个包含910个真实视觉网页任务的基准测试，用于评估多模态自主智能体在视觉与文本融合任务上的表现，结果显示当前最强多模态智能体的成功率（16.4%）远低于人类（88.7%），揭示了视觉理解和行动执行的显著差距。

papers.title: SeeClick: Harnessing GUI Grounding for Advanced Visual GUI Agents
papers.authors: Kanzhi Cheng, Qiushi Sun, Yougang Chu, Fangzhi Xu, Yantao Li, Jianbing Zhang, Zhiyong Wu
papers.affiliations: 南京大学计算机科学与技术系、上海人工智能实验室
papers.intro: 本文提出SeeClick，一个基于大型视觉语言模型的纯视觉GUI代理，通过自动化构建GUI定位数据进行预训练，显著提升屏幕元素定位能力，并创建跨平台基准ScreenSpot，在下游任务中展示了定位能力与代理性能的正相关性。

papers.title: GPT-4V(ision) is a Generalist Web Agent, if Grounded
papers.authors: Boyuan Zheng, Boyu Gou, Jihyung Kil, Huan Sun, Yu Su
papers.affiliations: The Ohio State University
papers.intro: 本文提出SEEACT，一个利用GPT-4V视觉理解能力生成文本计划并通过多种接地策略（结合HTML结构与视觉）转化为具体网页操作的通用网页代理，实验表明在oracle接地条件下GPT-4V表现优异（任务成功率51.1%），但接地仍是主要瓶颈，最佳接地策略与oracle仍有20-30%差距。

papers.title: AppAgent: Multimodal Agents as Smartphone Users
papers.authors: Chi Zhang, Zhao Yang, Jiaxuan Liu, Yucheng Han, Xin Chen, Zebiao Huang, Bin Fu, Gang Yu
papers.affiliations: Tencent
papers.intro: 本文提出一个基于多模态大语言模型的智能体框架AppAgent，通过自主探索或观察人类演示来学习操作智能手机应用，利用简化的点击、滑动等动作空间，在无需系统后端访问的情况下执行50个跨10个不同应用的复杂任务。

papers.title: ASSISTGUI: Task-Oriented Desktop Graphical User Interface Automation
papers.authors: Difei Gao, Lei Ji, Zechen Bai, Mingyu Ouyang, Peiran Li, Dongxing Mao, Qinchen Wu, Weichen Zhang, Peiyi Wang, Xiangwu Guo, Hengxu Wang, Luowei Zhou, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.affiliations: Show Lab, National University of Singapore
papers.intro: 本文提出了首个面向桌面GUI自动化任务的基准ASSISTGUI和一个基于Actor-Critic的具身智能体框架ACE，通过100个来自9款常用软件的任务评估模型操控鼠标和键盘的能力，实验表明最好模型仅达到46%成功率，揭示了现有方法的巨大改进空间。

papers.title: CogAgent: A Visual Language Model for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Wenyi Hong, Weihan Wang, Qingsong Lv, Jiazheng Xu, Wenmeng Yu, Junhui Ji, Yan Wang, Zihan Wang, Yuxuan Zhang, Juanzi Li, Bin Xu, Yuxiao Dong, Ming Ding, Jie Tang
papers.affiliations: 1Tsinghua University, 2Zhipu AI
papers.intro: CogAgent是一个18B参数的视觉语言模型，通过创新的高低分辨率双分支架构（低分辨率主干+高分辨率交叉注意力模块），在GUI理解和导航任务上超越基于LLM的方法，并在多项VQA基准上达到SOTA。

papers.title: TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal Large Language Model for Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Shuhuai Ren, Linli Yao, Shicheng Li, Xu Sun, Lu Hou
papers.affiliations: 北京大学多媒体信息处理国家重点实验室（School of Computer Science, Peking University）；华为诺亚方舟实验室（Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab）
papers.intro: TimeChat通过引入“时间戳感知帧编码器”和“滑动视频Q-Former”两个模块，使多模态大语言模型能够对任意长度的视频进行自适应压缩，并在零样本条件下实现准确的视频时间定位与理解。

papers.title: Explore, Select, Derive, and Recall: Augmenting LLM with Human-like Memory for Mobile Task Automation
papers.authors: Sunjae Lee, Junyoung Choi, Jungjae Lee, Munim Hasan Wasi, Hojun Choi, Steven Y. Ko, Sangeun Oh, Insik Shin
papers.affiliations: School of Computing, KAIST (Sunjae Lee, Junyoung Choi, Jungjae Lee, Munim Hasan Wasi, Hojun Choi, Insik Shin), Simon Fraser University (Steven Y. Ko), Korea University (Sangeun Oh), Fluiz Corp. (Insik Shin)
papers.intro: MobileGPT通过模仿人类“探索-选择-推导-回忆”的认知过程，构建分层记忆结构，使LLM能够准确、自适应且低成本地自动化移动任务，在185个任务上达到82.7%的新任务完成率和98.75%的上下文适应准确率。
